newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-CAMPESE PICKED FOR TWICKENHAM FAREWELL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CAMPESE PICKED FOR TWICKENHAM FAREWELL.

text.p: David Campese will make a farewell appearance at Twickenham on Saturday when Australia meet the Barbarians in the final match of their European tour.

Campese, who won his 101st and final test cap during the 28-19 victory over Wales, retains his place on the wing as the Wallabies look to preserve their 100 per cent tour record with a 12th successive win.

There are two other changes with New South Wales scrum half Sam Payne replacing George Gregan at scrum-half and Australian Capital Territories hooker Marco Caputo relegating Michael Foley to replacement duty.
Flanker Owen Finegan is being given time to recover from bumps and bruises sustained against Wales, but Daniel Manu is standing by.
Emergency second row pairing Tim Gavin and David Giffin team up again after dominating the Welsh line-out, with Warwick Waugh having flown home for further treatment on a shoulder problem.
Centre Tim Horan again skippers the side in tour captain John Eales' absence against opposition which Campese, among others, would have preferred to be the full England side.
"They can play the New Zealand Barbarians but they can't play Australia," said Campese. "I can't understand that."

Team: 15-Matthew Burke; 14-Joe Roff, 13-Jason Little, 12-Tim Horan (captain), 11-David Campese; 10-Pat Howard, 9-Sam Payne; 8-Michael Brial, 7-David Wilson, 6-Owen Finegan or Daniel Manu, 5-David Giffin, 4-Tim Gavin, 3-Andrew Blades, 2-Marco Caputo, 1-Dan Crowley.
